purpose: Determine whether the primary-source vector figures contain machine-recoverable incidence information sufficient to test a DED subfoam embedding into one of the seven DLD routings, without relying on visual resemblance alone.
frozen_requirements: Verify both exact EPS figure files exist in the pinned source archive and record hashes/bounding boxes.
Preserve raw vector/PostScript text, raster previews, and all source captions/figure labels.
Inventory explicit text labels and vector subobjects/paths if machine separable.

STRICT_MAP_READY only if the source figure representation exposes enough distinct machine-readable primitives to identify the DED complex, each DLD routing, and the candidate added internal edge/face without guessing from raster appearance.
Otherwise classify FIGURE_ONLY_REQUIRES_MANUAL_INCIDENCE_AUDIT; no refinement PASS is allowed.
claim_lock: Figure extraction does not itself prove a subfoam embedding or any amplitude identity.
